blurb: Guests take a fast, fun, and exciting eco-tour on real Everglades style airboats through the backwaters of West Bay, rivers, creeks, and marshlands. They search for native Florida wildlife including American bald eagles, ospreys, heron, dolphins, and alligators. The experience includes the only "full contact alligator experience" in Panama City Beach.
